policy: All reputation/PvP/crafting routes considered. No cost or grind limit. Raid-only dependencies excluded. Unverified routes are included in screening and flagged for verification before target publication.

19050.note: Materials checked against the recorded non-raid route

12640.where: Commission an Armorsmith who knows Lionheart Helm; availability confirmed by you. Non-raid Thorium, Arcanite, Wicked Claws and gems.
12640.note: Live availability confirmed by user on 2026-11-19

19044.where: Might of the Timbermaw: commission a Leatherworker with the Honored Timbermaw recipe. Rugged Leather, Powerful Mojo, Living Essence, Cured Rugged Hides and Rune Thread.

250617.where: Stormcarver: commission a Blacksmith with the Timbermaw Hold Revered plans from Felwood. 20 Legionite Bars, 10 Azerothium Bars, 2 Dense Grinding Stones; Fel Crystal has a Riverglades vendor route.

12784.where: Arcanite Reaper: commission an Axesmith. Plans from Bannok Grimaxe in Lower Blackrock Spire; 20 Arcanite Bars, 6 Enchanted Leather, 2 Dense Grinding Stones.

19325.where: Don Julio's Band — Frostwolf Clan Exalted; Jekyll Flandring/Grunnda Wolfheart, Alterac Valley quartermasters.

21326.where: Defender of the Timbermaw — Timbermaw Hold Exalted; The Root of All Evil quest.

20481.where: Spitfire Bracers: Cenarion Circle recipe; commission a Leatherworker. 1 Light Silithid Carapace, 20 Silithid Chitin, 2 Essence of Fire; outdoor Silithus/material routes.

252486.where: Ironfeather Leggings — commission a Leatherworker. Pattern 252895 drops from Firebrand Invokers in Lower Blackrock Spire. Materials: 20 Rugged Leather, 120 Ironfeathers, 4 Jade, 2 Cured Rugged Hides, 4 Rune Thread, 10 Pristine Scales, 20 Fel Leather. Pristine Scale has a Riverglades vendor; Fel Leather has an outdoor Hyjal skinning route.

272682.where: Premier High Warlord's Destroyer — Rank 14 PvP weapon; Honor vendor. Rank 14 is subject to the season's weekly progression cap, so this is a later goal, not an immediate purchase.

23203.where: Libram of Fervor — BoE world drop / Auction House. Reported legacy non-raid sources include level-60 outdoor mobs and Stratholme/Blackrock Spire trash; exact live Forever drop route remains unverified.
23203.note: Do not assume a guaranteed boss farm from the legacy world-drop table.

19289.where: Darkmoon Card: Maelstrom — collect/buy the eight Elementals cards, combine the Elementals Deck, and turn in Darkmoon Elementals Deck (7929) at the Darkmoon Faire. The Ace has dungeon/outdoor sources; confirm current card availability before buying.
19289.note: Simulator uses a 1-PPM carryover proc assumption; the live Forever rate is not verified. The Faire turn-in is event-dependent.

22676.where: Outrider's Mail Leggings — Kelm Hargunth, Warsong Gulch quartermaster in the Barrens. Legacy requirement: Warsong Outriders Exalted; verify current Forever standing and Honor/mark price at the vendor.
22676.note: Vendor route is recorded; the Exalted requirement comes from the legacy reward route and needs an in-game Forever check.

22385.where: Titanic Leggings — commission an Armorsmith who knows Plans: Titanic Leggings (22388), or buy the finished BoE legs. Rare world/lockbox non-raid plans routes are reported; confirm a crafter before gathering. Materials: 12 Arcanite Bars, 20 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 10 Essence of Earth, 2 Flasks of the Titans. Flask materials and its UBRS recipe have non-raid routes.
22385.note: Materials are non-raid. Exact live Forever plans drop source remains unverified; a reported world-drop route is not a guaranteed farm.

647.where: Destiny — BoE world drop / Auction House. The simulator records a measured 1.2-PPM proc rate; exact live drop tables are not guaranteed by this guide.
